details: The United States announced sanctions on June 2, 2026, targeting Iran's largest cryptocurrency exchange, Nobitex, along with three other digital asset platforms: Wallex, Bitpin, and Ramzinex. Washington accuses these exchanges of facilitating the Iranian government and blacklisted state institutions, including the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC), in circumventing Western sanctions. Nobitex reportedly processed a significant volume of digital transactions linked to the IRGC and Iran's central bank in 2025.
title: US Imposes Sanctions on Iran's Largest Cryptocurrency Exchange Amid Escalating Tensions
